Your Company has instituted a comprehensive, adequate and efficient system of internal controls that aligns with
its operational scale and complexity. These controls are designed to ensure the efficiency of operations, safeguard
assets, accuracy of financial reporting and adherence to internal policies, applicable laws and statutory requirements.
This internal control system is an integral part of the company’s corporate governance policy. Salient features
include the implementation of well-defined policies and procedures, structured delegation of powers, robust IT
and ERP systems, statutory and internal audits, effective functioning of the Audit Committee and other Board
Committees and compliance with Accounting Standards and Corporate Governance principles.
The Company has a dedicated Internal Audit department comprising experienced professionals including Chartered
Accountants, Cost & Management Accountants, System Analysts and Engineers. The Internal Audit focuses on
transparency and the robustness of internal controls. The annual audit programme, including audit frequency
and coverage, is approved by the Audit Committee at the start of each financial year. The Internal Audit team
evaluates the Company’s systems and processes, recommending corrective actions and control enhancements
to process owners. Key audit findings are periodically reviewed by the Audit Committee.
